dct_description_sm:
Includes data required to create York Region Official Plan – 2010 Map 7: Oak Ridges Moraine Aquifer Vulnerability Areas and Watershed Boundaries.  Data such on the Aquifer Vulnerability on Oak Ridges Moraine and boundaries of watersheds within York Region were used to create this map.

The data layers do not take the place of a legal survey or other primary source documentation and may not be used to determine, certify, or verify if a parcel is a qualifying or exempt property.
